title: TrustGraph: OntologyRAG Small-Schema Bypass & Cycle-Safe Subclass Domain/Range Validation
summary: TrustGraph's OntologyRAG pipeline pairs OntologySelector (top_k=10, similarity_threshold=0.3, bypass_selector_below=5) with TripleConverter strict class-constraint enforcement. Small ontologies whose total classes, object properties, and datatype properties fall below bypass_selector_below skip vector pruning in full. TripleConverter._get_ancestor_classes performs cycle-safe superclass traversal so convert_relationship enforces both domain and range and convert_attribute enforces domain constraints.

references.description: OntologySubset and OntologySelector with top_k=10, similarity_threshold=0.3, and bypass_selector_below=5
TripleConverter._get_ancestor_classes cycle guard, _matches_class_constraint, convert_relationship, and convert_attribute

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Bypass vector ontology pruning below small-schema element thresholds and validate extracted triples against domain/range constraints via cycle-safe superclass closure.
